important_interpretation: Recommended plucker values are headcount-equivalent field assignments, not a unique employee roster.
Field activation is inferred from historical active-field counts, weekday frequency and plucking-due score.
Bambarakelly, Tillicoultry and EildonHall use a final per-estate gate comparing their original method with the pooled technical method.
The lower-WAPE method is selected independently for each of the three estates.
All other estates continue with the existing gate-based planning methods.
The upper conservative crop and lower productivity rate are used for recommended assignment counts.
Stale source data increases uncertainty but is not silently presented as current operational data.
